title: Third-moment sum for Rademacher summands
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ be real numbers. For independent uniform signs $X_1,\ldots,X_n$, the sum of the third absolute moments of the summands $a_iX_i$ is $\sum_{i=1}^n |a_i|^3$.
hypotheses_covered: The sign vector is distributed uniformly on the sign cube
